title: Kinetic type reel (Canvas)
description: A studio-style kinetic typography reel: each phrase rises word by word through line masks, an accent circle lands as the full stop and then swells to become the next phrase's ground, over a drifting dot grid with film grain. Copy is auto-fitted with measured glyphs. Works at any aspect ratio.

phrases.description: On-screen phrases in order, one per beat; 2-5 words each read best

palette.description: Ground, ink and accent; grounds alternate between ground and accent

weight.description: Font weight (Inter or the system sans)

tempo.description: Speed of entrances and the circle wipe

grid.description: Opacity of the drifting dot grid

accent_last_word.description: Set the final phrase's last word in the accent colour

ending.description: Keep the breathing full stop on the final phrase

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
